name: Bay City Plant (Ziploc) - Bay City MI

fieldNotes.truckGate: Large perimeter-fenced campus (chain-link fencing confirmed in Street View along the property edge). Buildings sit behind the fence with controlled access drives; classified as a gated site.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No manned guard booth positively identified at any entrance from available Street View; entrances appear to be fenced drives without a visible booth. Left false but flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the basis that a gated/fenced site with no visible guard booth implies kiosk / call-box / remote check-in. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal campus roads run several hundred metres from public road to dock faces; ample queue depth.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Sprawling campus with multiple building access drives; inbound and outbound flows are not pinched through one common gate. Approximate call.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Large empty paved overflow/staging lots beside the warehouse leave abundant room for express-lane buildout.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Multiple dock banks across the warehouse and production buildings; trailers backed in observed on at least three building faces. ~45 doors estimated, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Fan-pattern rows of parked trailers near the north warehouse and rows near the core production buildings; clear drop-yard activity, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity on physically separate buildings (north warehouse vs core production cluster).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: SC Johnson Bay City is a campus of ~6 production buildings plus warehouse, office and R&D structures on one ~400-acre property.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail lines run along the east edge of the property with rail-served lots adjacent; the campus footprint borders active rail. Rail service likely; flagged medium.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified; left false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: SC Johnson states the Bay City site is more than 400 acres; much of it is undeveloped land. Perimeter box approximates the property; ~400 acres per company figure.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Bay City setting with adjacent residential and farmland/open land; judged Rural per rubric (small-city industrial).
